title: 的, 得 or 地 (de)? HSK 2 Chinese Grammar with Examples
description: 的, 得 and 地 all sound like de. Learn which one to write: 的 before a noun, 地 before a verb, 得 after a verb, with HSK 2 examples and common mistakes.
h1: 的, 得 or 地: Which de to Use
lede: 的, 得 and 地 are all pronounced de with a neutral tone, so you only need to tell them apart when you write. Look at where de sits: 的 comes before a noun, 地 comes before a verb, and 得 comes after a verb.

paras: Look at the words on either side of de. If a noun comes after it, write 的. If a verb comes after it, write 地. If de comes straight after a verb and is followed by a comment on how the action went, such as 很快 or 很好, write 得.
In speech the three sound exactly the same, so nobody will misunderstand you. In writing, textbooks and HSK exams keep them apart, and the wrong one counts as a mistake.
的 links an owner or a description to the noun after it: 我的 (my), 老师的 (the teacher's), 很漂亮的 (very pretty), 我买的 (that I bought). The description always comes first, then 的, then the noun.
When everyone knows which thing you mean, the noun can be left out, so a sentence can also end in 的: 这是我的 means "this is mine". The page on 的 covers this in more detail.

examples.zh: 她有一件很漂亮的衣服。
examples.py: Tā yǒu yí jiàn hěn piàoliang de yīfu.
examples.en: She has a very pretty top.

examples.py: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi de shū hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: The book I bought yesterday is really good.

sections.h2: 得 after a verb: how well, how fast
paras: Verb + 得 + comment. 得 comes right after the verb and introduces a comment on how the action is done: how well, how fast, how early. The comment is usually an adjective, often with 很 in front of it.

If the verb has an object, either say the verb twice (说汉语说得很好) or put the object first (汉语说得很好). The object never goes between the verb and 得. For the negative, put 不 after 得: 跑得不快. To ask, put 怎么样 or a yes-no form such as 快不快 after 得.

examples.py: Tā Hànyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.
Tā měitiān shuì de hěn wǎn.
examples.en: He goes to bed very late every day.

examples.py: Wǒ chàng gē chàng de bù hǎo.

sections.h2: 地 before a verb: the way someone does something
paras: Description + 地 + verb. 地 turns a word into a description of the action, a bit like -ly in English: 高兴地说 (say happily), 慢慢地走 (walk slowly). The description and 地 always come before the verb.

The word in front of 地 is often a two-syllable adjective such as 高兴, a doubled word such as 慢慢 or 好好, or an adjective with 很, such as 很快. Doubled words can also go straight in front of the verb without 地: 慢慢走 is fine too.

examples.zh: 他高兴地说：“我找到工作了！”
examples.py: Tā gāoxìng de shuō: "Wǒ zhǎodào gōngzuò le!"
examples.en: He said happily, "I've found a job!"

examples.py: Tā mànmàn de dǎkāi le mén.
Tā hěn kuài de chuānshang le yīfu.
examples.en: He quickly put his clothes on.

sections.h2: 得 or 地? Common mistakes
paras: Some ideas can be said with either 地 or 得, but the word order changes. 地 goes before the verb and describes the way someone does something. 得 goes after the verb and gives a comment on how it was done, and that comment ends the sentence.

The most common mistake is writing 的 after a verb: 他跑的很快 should be 他跑得很快. You will see this a lot in casual writing online, but it is marked wrong in exams. The other is putting the object after 得: 他说得汉语很好 should be 他汉语说得很好 or 他说汉语说得很好.

worksheet.title: 的, 得 or 地 Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 的, 得 and 地 worksheet for HSK 2: 20 exercises (choose the right de, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.h2: Choose 的, 得 or 地
exercises.instructions: Write 的, 得 or 地 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: The children are playing happily outside.
The film I saw yesterday was very good.
You should get a good rest.
He doesn't speak Chinese very well.
How did you sleep last night?

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: My older brother is a very good swimmer.
Mum walked slowly over to us.
The fruit I bought was very cheap.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 我昨天买得衣服很漂亮。
items.en: The clothes I bought yesterday are very pretty.
answers: 我昨天买的衣服很漂亮。
